name: dsh-org-talent
description: Organization-wide employee matching in the DSH left sidebar: a project guide with searchable progress, stage outcomes, recent projects and blocker/difficulty/change alerts synced from feedback; a requirement pool; a workspace that opens one DSH conversation per project and sends task details; a talent pool; an org chart; team matching; capability advice; skill research and project feedback. Import CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown or XLSX. · 左侧栏的组织人才匹配：可检索的项目进度、项目成果、近期项目与同步预警，需求池，按项目创建的 DSH 对话工作区，人才库，组织架构，全组织团队匹配，能力培养建议与技能检索；支持多种文件导入。
